card.fires_on: Linking words such as from, to, on and over right after a noun or verb of extent, when a region, front or stretch of land is about to be named.

modes.label: Spread over a region
modes.description: over or on before a named place or front where something happens.
modes.example: For decades the Chickasaw conducted slave raids<< over>> a wide region.
